title: #22. The Battle Of Badr Part 2
arabic:
اَعُوْذُ بِاللهِ مِنَّ الشِّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيْمِ۝بِسْمِ اللهِ الرَّحْمَانِ الرَّحِيْمَ۝

اَلْحَمْدُ لله ، وَالصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلى سَيِّدِنَا محمد وَعَلَى اَلِهِ وَصَحْبِهِ وَسَلِّمْ تَسْلِيْمًا كَثِيْراَّ اَفَلَا اَمِتُّمْ كِرَامًا

اَعَلَی لَّلّهُ وَرَسُوْلِهِ تُحَّرِّضِيِنْ وَسَاعَتْ فِيْ اَخْلَاقُنَا يَسْأَلُونَكَ عَنِ الْأَنْفَالِ ۖ قُلِ الْأَنْفَالُ لِلَّهِ وَالرَّسُولِ ۖ

Allahعَزّوجَلّ says; وَاعْلَمُوا أَنَّمَا غَنِمْتُمْ مِنْ شَيْءٍ فَأَنَّ لِلَّهِ خُمُسَهُ وَلِلرَّسُولِ وَلِلرَّسُولِ وَلِذِي الْقُرْبَىٰ وَالْيَتَامَىٰ وَالْمَسَاكِينِ وَابْنِ السَّبِيلِ

إِنْ كُنْتُمْ آمَنْتُمْ بِاللَّهِ وَمَا أَنْزَلْنَا عَلَىٰ عَبْدِنَا يَوْمَ الْفُرْقَانِ يَوْمَ الْفُرْقَانِ يَوْمَ الْتَقَى الْجَمْعَانِ ۗ وَاللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ۝

Allahعَزّوجَلّ says; مَا كَانَ لِنَبِيٍّ أَنْ يَكُونَ لَهُ أَسْرَىٰ حَتَّىٰ يُثْخِنَ فِي الْأَرْضِ ۚ تُرِيدُونَ عَرَضَ الدُّنْيَا وَاللَّهُ يُرِيدُ الْآخِرَةَ ۗ وَاللَّهُ عَزِيزٌ حَكِيمٌ۝

لَوْلَا كِتَابٌ مِنَ اللَّهِ سَبَقَ لَمَسَّكُمْ فِيمَا أَخَذْتُمْ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٌ۝

Allahعَزّوجَلّ says; مَا حَمَلَكَ عَلَى مَا صَنَعَتْ لا اله الا الله حَبَّبَ إِلَيْكُمُ الْإِيمَانَ وَزَيَّنَهُ فِي قُلُوبِكُمْ سَيُهْزَمُ الْجَمْعُ وَيُوَلُّونَ الدُّبُرَ۝

بَلِالسَّاعَةُ مَوْعِدُهُمْ وَالسَّاعَةُ أَدْهَىٰ وَأَمَرُّ۝

إِذْ تَسْتَغِيثُونَ رَبَّكُمْ فَاسْتَجَابَ لَكُمْ أَنِّي مُمِدُّكُمْ بِأَلْفٍ مِنَ الْمَلَائِكَةِ مُرْدِفِينَ۝

فَلَمْ تَقْتُلُوهُمْ وَلَٰكِنَّ اللَّهَ قَتَلَهُمْ ۚ وَمَا رَمَيْتَ إِذْ رَمَيْتَ وَلَٰكِنَّ اللَّهَ رَمَىٰ وَلِيُبْلِيَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ مِنْهُ بَلَاءً حَسَنًا

إِنَّ اللَّهَ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌ۝

وَمَا رَمَيْتَ إِذْ رَمَيْتَ قم يا حمزه' قم يا عبيده'قم يا علي هَٰذَانِ خَصْمَانِ اخْتَصَمُوا فِي رَبِّهِمْ ۖ اَشْهَدُ اَنَّكَ شَهِيْدْ Allahعَزّوجَلّ says,

هَٰذَانِ خَصْمَانِ اخْتَصَمُوا فِي رَبِّهِمْۖ فَالَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا قُطِّعَتْ لَهُمْ ثِيَابٌ مِنْنَارٍ يُصَبُّ مِنْ فَوْقِ رُءُوسِهِمُ الْحَمِيمُ۝

يُصْهَرُ بِهِ مَا فِي بُطُونِهِمْ وَالْجُلُودُ۝

وَلَهُمْ مَقَامِعُ مِنْ حَدِيدٍ۝

كُلَّمَا أَرَادُوا أَنْ يَخْرُجُوا مِنْهَا مِنْ غَمٍّ أُعِيدُوا فِيهَا أُعِيدُوا فِيهَا وَذُوقُوا عَذَابَ الْحَرِيقِ۝

انَّ اللَّهَ يُدْخِلُ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ جَنَّاتٍ جَنَّاتٍ تَجْرِي مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ يُحَلَّوْنَ فِيهَامِنْ أَسَاوِرَ مِنْ ذَهَبٍ وَلُؤْلُؤًا ۖ

وَلِبَاسُهُمْ فِيهَا حَرِيرٌ۝

وَهُدُوا إِلَى الطَّيِّبِ مِنَ الْقَوْلِ وَهُدُوا إِلَىٰ صِرَاطِ الْحَمِيدِ۝

قَدْ كَانَ لَكُمْ آيَةٌ فِي فِئَتَيْنِ الْتَقَتَاۖ فِئَةٌ تُقَاتِلُ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ وَأُخْرَىٰ كَافِرَةٌ يَرَوْنَهُمْ مِثْلَيْهِمْ رَأْيَ الْعَيْنِۚ

وَاللَّهُ يُؤَيِّدُ بِنَصْرِهِ مَنْ يَشَاءُ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَعِبْرَةً لِأُولِي الْأَبْصَارِ۝

Allahعَزّوجَلّ says; وَلَقَدْ نَصَرَكُمُ اللَّهُ بِبَدْرٍ وَأَنْتُمْ أَذِلَّةٌ فَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ۝

إِذْ تَقُولُ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ أَلَنْ يَكْفِيَكُمْ أَنْ يُمِدَّكُمْ رَبُّكُمْ بِثَلَاثَةِ آلَافٍ بِثَلَاثَةِ آلَافٍ مِنَ الْمَلَائِكَةِ مُنْزَلِينَ۝

بَلَىٰ إِنْ تَصْبِرُوا وَتَتَّقُوا وَيَأْتُوكُمْ مِنْ فَوْرِهِمْ هَٰذَا هَٰذَا يُمْدِدْكُمْ رَبُّكُمْ بِخَمْسَةِ آلَافٍ مِنَ الْمَلَائِكَةِ مُسَوِّمِينَ۝

وَمَا جَعَلَهُ اللَّهُ إِلَّا بُشْرَىٰ لَكُمْ وَلِتَطْمَئِنَّ قُلُوبُكُمْ بِهِ وَمَا النَّصْرُ إِلَّا مِنْ عِنْدِ اللَّهِ الْعَزِيزِ الْحَكِيمِ۝

غِدِّيْ اَبْ هَيْزُوْمْ ، اَقْدِمْ هَيْزُوْمْ غِدِّيْ اَبْ هَيْزُوْمْ ، اَقْدِمْ، اَقْدِمْ هَيْزُوْمْ اَقْدِمْ هَيْزُوْمْ ،غِدِّيْ اَبْ هَيْزُوْمْ ،

لَقَدْاِرْتَقَيْتَ مُرْتَقًا صعْبًا يَا رُوَيعِيَّ الْغَنَمْ اَتَضْحَكُوْنَ لِدِقَّة سَاقيه قَاتِلُوهُمْ يُعَذِّبْهُمُ اللَّهُ بِأَيْدِيكُمْ وَيُخْزِهِمْوَيَنْصُرْكُمْ عَلَيْهِمْ وَيَشْفِ صُدُورَ قَوْمٍ مُؤْمِنِينَ۝

وَيُذْهِبْ غَيْظَ قُلُوبِهِمْ ۗ وَيَتُوبُ اللَّهُعَلَىٰ مَنْ يَشَاءُ ۗ وَاللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٌ۝

رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ۝

وَصَلَّى الله عَلى سَيَّدِنَا محمد وَعَلى اَلِهِ وَ صَحْبِهِ وَسَلِّمْ تَسْلِيْمًا كَثِيْرًا وَالسلام عليكم ورحمة الله وبركاته
english:
The Life of Muhammadﷺ, The Madinan Period, Volume 1 By Imam Anwar Al_Awlaki, Rasool Allah ﷺ sends Abdullah Bin Rawaha(عبدالله بن رواحة) and Zaid Bin Harissa (زيد بن حارثه)

to deliver the news to the people of Madina.

Abdullah Bin Rawaha(عبدالله بن رواحة) goes to Awali(عوالي), the upper areas of Madina and he delivers the news to each house of Al-Ansaar(ألأنصار),

while Zaid Bin Harissa(زيد بن حارثه) goes to the center of Madina to deliver the news.

Now Zaid Bin Harissa(زيد بن حارثه) was riding on the camel of Rasool Allah ﷺ.

So, when he came in, delivering the news and saying that Ut'bah Bin Rabiyah(عتبة بن ربيعة) was killed, Shaibah Bin Rabiyah(شيبة بن ربيعة) was killed

Ibn Al-Hajjaj(إبن الحجاج) were killed, Abu Jahal(ابو جَهَل) was killed and he was mentioning the famous names of the people of Quraish(قُرَيْشْ), who were killed.

The Munafiqeen(منافقين) and the Yahood(يهود) said; This man doesn't know what he's talking about, he's confused and he has run away from the battlefield,

and Muhammad(محمد) himself was killed and the evidence is that Zaid(زيد) is riding his camel.

And they went around spreading this news.

So, Usamah(اسامه) said: I went to my father's Zaid(زيد) because Usamah(اسامه) was left behind, he stayed in Madina to care for Ruqayyah(رقية).

Usamah(اسامه) and Uthman(عثمان) stayed behind to care for Ruqayyah(رقية) the daughter of Rasool Allah ﷺ.

So, Usamah(اسامه) said; I went to my father and said; O, Father is the news that you're delivering, true.?

He said, Yes, my son it is true.

People were going to Abdullah Bin Rawaha(عبدالله بن رواحة) and saying is that news true?

He would say; yes, the news is true and tomorrow Rasool Allah ﷺ is going to bring the captives.

It was so difficult for people to believe what happened, a force of little over 300 defeats a 1000 and then kills the most famous names of Quraish(قُرَيْشْ), all of them are dead

Ut'bah(عتبة), Shaibah(شيبة), Al-Waleed(الوليد), Abu Jahal(ابو جَهَل), Nabeeha Al-Munabbah(نبيحه ألمنبه), Ibn Al-Hajjaj(إبن ألحجاج) and others,

all of them were killed on that day.

And then other leaders, such as Sohail Ibn Amr(سهيل إبن عمرو), are captured, taken as prisoners.

So, it was too good to be true, but the next day, Rasool Allah ﷺ does come in with the prisoners and the victory of Allahعَزّوجَلّ.

Now, the prisoners were placed in a certain location and Sodah(سؤده), the wife of Rasool Allah ﷺ when she saw Sohail Bin Amr(سهيل إبن عمرو) with his hands tied to his neck.

And this was one of the noblemen of Quraish(قُرَيْشْ).

She said: Why didn't you die as nobleman?

Why did you allow yourselves to be humiliated and to be in this state?

Why didn't you, die as nobleman.

Rasool Allah ﷺ overlooked that statement and said; Are you asking them to fight Allah and His Messenger?

Because in fact, what she was saying is, why didn't you fight rather than be held captive, the way you are, and when she is saying why didn't he fight, who would he fight against.?

He would be fighting against Rasool Allah ﷺ.

So, Sodah(سؤده) said: She apologized, to Rasool Allah ﷺ and said, O Messenger of Allah, When I saw him in that state, I couldn't, but say such a statement.

Her emotions overwhelmed her, when she saw Sohail(سهيل) in that state.

So, it tells you that the leaders of Quraish(قُرَيْشْ) were humiliated because of their disbelief and Kuffr(كفر) and the way they dealt with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ,

most of them were killed and then you have the people like SohailIbn Amr(سهيل إبن عمرو) are tied in ropes.

Rasool Allah ﷺ stopped at Ar-Rohaa(ألروحاء) to receive congratulations, from all of the people that were coming to visit him.

And when the people were coming to congratulate him one of the Ansaar(ألأنصار) said: What are you congratulating us for, We have only met old, bald men, like camels awaiting slaughter

and we slaughtered them.

Rasool Allah ﷺ said, Hey my cousin, Don't say that, these are the chiefs.

This Ansaari(اَنصاري) was saying it was so easy, those people whom we faced are old men who don't know how to fight.

It was Allah who helped you, through the angels, otherwise we couldn't have defeated such an army.

So, these are strong men, it was a strong opponent, but Allahعَزّوجَلّ assisted us, and helped us.

The news was delivered to Makkah by a man called Al-Haithamaan Al-Khuza'ee(ألحُيْسمان ألخزاعي) Al-Haithamaan Al-Khuza'ee(ألحُيْسمان ألخزاعي) rushes into Makkah and says,

Abul Hakam(ابو الكحم) was killed, Ut'ba(عتبة) was killed, Shaibah(شيبة) was killed, Al-Waleed(الوليد) was killed, and he's going down the list,

and Ummayyah(اميه) was killed.

Safwaan Ibn Ummayyah(صفوان ابن اميه) was listening.

And he said: This man has lost his mind.

Ask him about me, to make sure that, he isn't crazy.

So, they asked him.

What about Safwaan(صفوان), what happened to him.?

He said; Safwaan(صفوان) is sitting right there.

And I have seen the death of his father and his brother with my own eyes.

And for the people of Makkah it was too bad to be true.

How could Abu Jahal(ابو جَهَل) be killed, and Ummayyah(اميه) be killed, and Ut'ba(عتبة) be killed?

It's impossible, but surely the news was sinking in.

Abu Lahab(ابولهب) was one of those, who stayed behind, but he sent somebody in his place to fight.

Raafiah(رافع) says that I was a servant of Al-Abbas(العباس) and our household was Muslim, Me and Al-Abbas(العباس) and Ummul Fazal(أم الفضل),

Ummul Fazal(أم الفضل) is the wife ofAl-Abbas(العباس), we were Muslim.

And I used to make arrows.

So, I was sitting in the pavilion around the Al-Ka'aba(اَلْكَعْبَه), sharpening arrows, while Abu Lahab(ابولهب) was sitting with his back towards me,

when one of the fighters from Quraish(قُرَيْشْ) approached.

So, Abu Lahab(ابولهب) said; Come and tell us the news of what happened?

So, the man came and he said; As soon as the fighting started we handed them over ourselves to be killed and to be taken as captives.

But I don't blame them for it, because we were facing men in white clothes on horses, between the heavens and earth, and nothing can stop them.

So, he was saying that it is true that we were defeated by the army of Rasool Allah ﷺ.

But we don't give credit to them.

It was some other people wearing white who defeated us and nothing could stop that force.

When Raafiah(رافع) heard that, he said, In the name of Allah, those are the angels.

Abu Lahab(ابولهب) turned around and punched him in the face, such a blow.

Raafiah(رافع) said: So, I started fighting back but Abu Lahab(ابولهب) was stronger than me and I was a weak man So, he was sitting over me and beating me hard,

when Ummul Fazal(أم الفضل) came with a rod and she hit Abu Lahab(ابولهب) on the head and told him; You are taking advantage that his master is not around.

Then Abu Lahab(ابولهب) left.

Raafiah(رافع) says, that Abu Lahab(ابولهب) was afflicted by disease after that and died a week later.

And he said this particular disease would terrify the people of Quraish(قُرَيْشْ).

And if somebody is inflicted with that disease, they wouldn't want to go next to him.

So, Abu Lahab(ابولهب) died and remained in his house for three days until, his body was decomposing, and nobody wants to bury him.

So, The people of Quraish(قُرَيْشْ) went to his two sons and said, I mean, shame on you, your father, his body is decomposing, and you don't want to bury him.

They said, well, we're afraid of that disease.

So what they did is, they ended up dragging him and placing him next to a wall.

They didn't even dig a grave for him, they placed him next to wall, and then they threw stones over him to cover his body.

That is the humiliation that he suffered, even in his death.

The people of Quraish(قُرَيْشْ) in order not to have the Muslims rejoice at their misfortune prevented anyone from crying publicly for the dead.

So, there was no wailing allowed.

Also, they refused to allow anybody to investigate the issue of ransoming, the prisoners.

So that Muhammadﷺ will not raise the price of ransom.

Ibn Kathir(اِبْنِ كَثِيْر), He says about this.

He said, I observe that Allah's forcing them to forego mourning for their dead was part of the totality of His punishment, of those of them that remained alive at that time,

for weeping for the dead contributes to the recovery of the grieving heart.

So, this prevention of mourning was in fact more of a torment for the people of Quraish(قُرَيْشْ), the ones who are living.

And then he says, Ibn Is'haqq(اِبْنِ اِسْحَاقْ) stated Al-Aswad Ibn Al-Muttalib(ألأسود ابن المطلب) was afflicted with the loss of three of his sons.

This was an old man, he was already blind, and he lost three of his sons and he wasn't allowed to mourn their deaths.

So, one night he hears a woman weeping.

So, he said; Go and see if mourning has become permissible are Quraish(قُرَيْشْ) now be wailing their dead, perhaps I will now be able to lament the loss of Abu Hakima(ابوحكيمه), his eldest son,

for I am in great pain.

So, they went to find out why the woman was crying?

They found out she's crying because he lost a camel.

So, he says these lines of poetry, he said, Is she weeping because of a camel of hers has gone astray...

And so insomnia keeps her from sleeping...

Do not weep over young camel...

But over Badr(بدر) that ruined all hopes...

over Badr(بدر) and the elite of the Bannu Husais(بنو هصيص) and Makhzoom(مخذوم)...

And the tribe of Abul Waleed(أبو الوليد)...

And weep if you weep at all...

For Abu Aqeel(أبو عقيل)... And for Harris(حارث)...

The Lion of lions, Weep for them all and do not hold back...

For there is none, The like of Abu Hakeema(ابوحكيمة)...

after them it is other men who rule, and had it not been for Badr(بدر)...

They would not have come to lead...

So, this poor old man wasn't even allowed to mourn the loss of his three sons.

Why?

So, that the news wouldn't reach to Muhammadﷺ that the Kuffar(كفار) of Quraish(قُرَيْشْ) are suffering because of their dead, they wanted to show they don't care about it.

And they wanted to show that, they don't care about the ransom of the captives.

Surat-Al-Anfaal(سورة الأنفال) was revealed, after the Ghazwa(غزوة) of Badr(بدر).

Ubadah Bin Samit(عبادة بن الصامت) says about the first verses of Surat-Al-Anfaal(سورة الأنفال).

They were revealed about us, The Muslims at Badr(بدر).

When we disputed the issue of booty and we were disputing with one another about it.

What happened was the Muslims were three groups one group was protecting Rasool Allah ﷺ, the second group was pursuing the enemy and the third group were collecting the spoils of war.

So, the ones who collected the spoils of war said, these belong to us.

The ones, who protected Rasool Allah ﷺ said; No, we want our share because we are protecting Rasool Ullah.

And the ones who are pursuing the enemy said; If it wasn't for us you wouldn't have any spoils of war.

So, they disputed and they were arguing and Allahعَزّوجَلّ revealed the Ayaat(آيات) of Surat-Al-Anfaal(سورة الأنفال).

Allahعَزّوجَلّ says: They ask you, O Muhammad(محمد) about the bounties of war, say the decision concerning bounties is for Allah and the Messenger.

Therefore all of the boundaries of war were taken from them, and given to Rasool Allah ﷺ.

It belongs to Allah and Rasool Ullah, all of it was taken away.

And then Allah says; So, fear Allah and amend that which is between you and obey Allah and His Messenger, if you should be believers.

Now when battle started, suddenly the numbers changed the perception of the size of the Muslim army, changes.

So, the Mushrikeen(مشركين), who are 1000 see the Muslims as being 2000, when they were only 317 or 319.

Allahعَزّوجَلّ says in Qur'an, Already there has been for you a sign in the two armies which met, one fighting in the cause of Allah, and another of disbelievers.

They saw them to be twice their own number by their eyesight.

But Allah supports with His victory, whom He wills.

Indeed, in that is a lesson for those of vision.

So, in the beginning, they see them as less than their own number, so that they would be careless and they would be willing to fight.

However, when fighting does actually start, they will see them as double their numbers, so that this will destroy their morale.

And the Muslims had the battle cry, a war cry and that was Ahad(أحد), Ahad(أحد), Ahad(أحد), Ahad(أحد), One, One, One, One that was their war cry.

And this was something that the Muslims would employ in their battles, they would have a certain a fixed war cry that they would keep on repeating.

Harissa رضي الله عنه, one of the Al-Ansaar(ألأنصار) was shot by a stray arrow, so he was killed by friendly fire.

When The battle was over, and his mother met with Rasool Allah ﷺ.

She said; Tell me whether Harissa(حارثه) is in Paradise, so that I'll be happy or if he's not, then I'll cry for him.

Rasool told her; Have you gone crazy.

There are plenty ofgardens in Paradise, and your son has earned the very highest of them.

Your son is in the highest level of Jannah(جنة).

Because Allahعَزّوجَلّ has prepared exclusively for the Mujahideen(مجاهدين) One Hundred levels on top of Al-Jannah(جنة) and Harissa(حارثه) is in the highest one.

And already had Allah given you victory at the Battle of Badr(بدر), while you were weak, meaning few in number, then fear Allah perhaps you will be grateful.

Remember when you said to the believers is it not sufficient for you that your Lord should reinforce you with 3000 Angels sent down, previously We said, it was thousand.

So, that was the minimum number Allahعَزّوجَلّ could have sent to them.

But then the number could be 3000 or it could be more like 5000.

And then Allah says; Yes If you remain patient and conscious of Allah and they, the enemy come upon you attacking in rage your Lord will reinforce you with 5000 angels having marks of distinction

and Allah made it not accept as a sign of good tidings for you and to reassure your hearts thereby.

And victory is not accept from Allah, meaning you don't really need the Angels.

This was a sign of good tidings for you and to reassure your hearts and victory is not except from Allah, the Exalted in Might, the Wise.

So, in what form did the Angels participate in this battle.

Jibreel(جِبْرِيْل) himself joined in Rasool Allah ﷺ says; I saw Jibreel(جِبْرِيْل) taking his horse by the reins and leading it.

And all of the angels were wearing white turbans, except Jibreel(جِبْرِيْل), he was wearing a yellow one to distinguish him.

He was the leader of the army of angels on that day.

In Sahih Muslim(صحيح مسلم), it says while one of the Muslim warriors was vigorously pursuing one of the unbelievers ahead of him, He heard above him the noise of a whip striking

and a rider's voice saying: When the Muslim warrior looked at the Polytheist in front of him, he found him prostrate on the ground.

Examining him more closely, he found that the man's nose has been smashed and his face split apart by a blow from a whip, all having turned black in color.

So, this was a whip of fire.

The warrior, An Ansaari(انصاري), went and told this, to the Messenger of Allah, Who said; You speak true that was help from the third heaven.

So, this was an angel riding on a horse called Hayzoom(هيزوم) And he was saying: Ibn Is'haqq(اِبْنِ اِسْحَاقْ) narrates another story, he said;

A Ghafari(غفاري) man said, I and a cousin of mine, were present at Badr(بدر), though we were still Polytheist, then.

So, these were two young men who were Mushrikeen(مشركين), and they were there just to watch the battle they wanted to see who would win, they had no quarrel with either side, they had nothing to do with the battle

they just went there as spectators.

We were up on a mountain waiting for the battle to take place and to see, who would win.

When a cloud approached.

When it drew near the mountain we heard the sound of horses galloping, and a voice saying; My companion suffered a heart attack and died on the spot,

while I almost expired, but later recovered.

So, this was quite a shock for these two men, one of them had a heart attack.

Al-Mazini(ألمازني) says; that while I was pursuing one of the Mushrikeen(مشركين), in front of me suddenly in his head flew off.

So I realized that he was killed by someone other than me.

And they could distinguish the casualties, caused by the angels compared to those caused by the believers.

Anas Ibn Malik(أنس إبن مالك) said; Our men could differentiate the ones, the angels had killed from those, they had struck by the blow having occurred above their necks and by their fingertips looking as if they had been burned by a branding iron.

So, the deaths that were caused by the angels, you can know that these were caused by the angels, first of all, because it was a clean cut and then because it was black, it was burned, as if it was a branding iron, that was striking them.

Not only did the angels kill but they also captured prisoners of war.

Al-Abbas(العباس) says; Ya'ani(يعني) when one of Al-Ansaar(ألأنصار) was dragging Al-Abbas(العباس) and he's saying that he captured him.

Al-Abbas(العباس) said; O Messenger ofAllah, this is not the man, who captured me.

A bald, fine looking man on a pie bald horse, whom I had not seen with your men, was he, who took me prisoner.

So, The Ansaari(أنصاري) said: No, It was I, who captured him, O Messenger of Allah.

And then Rasool Allah ﷺ said: Keep quiet! Allah gave you help of a noble Angel.

Ibn Abbas رضي الله عنهsaid; the only battle in which the angels participated was at Badr(بدر) at the other battles, they constituted auxiliaries and reinforcements, that did not actually fight.

The death toll seventy Mushrikeen(مشركين), were killed and 70 were taken prisoners of war.

Among the Muslims, no prisoners of war whatsoever.

And there were 14 deaths, Six from among Al-Muhajiroon(ألمهاجرون), six from among Al-Khazraj(ألخزرج), and two from among Al-Aos(ألأوس).

Some scenes from the battlefield.

Abdur Rahman Ibn Auf رضي الله عنه, said; he was flanked by two young men in the rank in the line, in the battle.

He was flanked by two youngmen.

Now, soldiers, know, you want to have good soldiers on your right and on your left.

You want to have good fighting companions, by your side.

Abdur Rahman Ibn Auf(عبدالرحمن إبن عوف) wasn't happy that he has these two kids next to him.

Abdur Rahman(عبدالرحمن) was a mature man.

And he had these young men next to him.

So he preferred to have someone else flanking him.

And then he said the one to my right.

He whispered to me and said; O uncle show me which one is Abu Jahal(ابو جَهَل).

Abdur Rahman Ibn Auf(عبدالرحمن إبن عوف) said; O, my son, What do you want with Abu Jahal(ابو جَهَل).

This young man said; I swore to Allah, that if I saw him, I would kill him or die in front of him.

Either I kill him or I die right there.

So, now Abdur Rahman Ibn Auf(عبدالرحمنإبن عوف) is starting to change his mind about who's flanking him.

You know, Don't base your opinion based on the looks.

Don't make a judgment based on the looks.

This man right next to you wants to kill Abu Jahal(ابو جَهَل), the leader of the army of Al-Mushrikeen(المشركين).

And then he points out Abu Jahal(ابو جَهَل) to this young man to his right.

Now the young man to his left whispers in the ear of Abdur Rahman Ibn Auf(عبدالرحمن إبن عوف) and asked him the same question.

And the reason why, they're whispering is.?

These two brothers were competing with each other.

So they were whispering to Abdur Rahman Ibn Auf(عبدالرحمن إبن عوف), so that other one doesn't hear.

Abdur Rahman Ibn Auf(عبدالرحمن إبن عوف) said; When I showed Abu Jahal(ابو جَهَل) to them, and he pointed out and he said; See that man, you know, it was like a crowd around Abu Jahal(ابو جَهَل), all of them protecting him,

so he pointed out Abu Jahal(ابو جَهَل) and said that's Abu Jahal(ابو جَهَل).

Abdur Rahman Ibn Auf(عبدالرحمن إبن عوف) said, they flew at him like Falcons.

This was in Al-Bukhari(البخاريْ), they flew at him as Falcons, and they struck him down.

They struck Abu Jahal(ابو جَهَل) down, two young men, from among Al-Ansaar(الأنْصَار).

These two young men, according to one narration are Muadh Ibn Amr BinJamooh(معاذ إبن عمرو بن الجموح) and Muawwiz(معوذ) or Auf Bin Afraah(عوف بن أفراح).

And in another narration, they are two brothers, Auf(عوف) and Muawwiz Bin Ibn Al-Hariss(معوذ بن حارث), whose mother was Afrah(أفراح).

In another narration, it says that when they attacked Abu Jahal(ابوجَهَل), and they reached next to him.

One of them struck the foot of Abu Jahal(ابوجَهَل).

So, it flew off like a kernel of nut would fly off from the Nut cracker.

And it made that sound of a crack and then it flew off.

But then Ikrimah(إكرمه) saw that and he struck Muadh(معاذ) on his shoulder and he tore off his arm.

However, the arm remained, hanging to his body by the flesh of his side, of his chest.

So, the joint itself is tore away, is cut, but the arm is still is just dangling by his side.

And Muadh(معاذ) said: I carried on fighting, dragging my arm behind me, until it started bothering me and distracting me from fighting, so I placed it under my foot and stepped over it and tore it off.

That's quite a thing to do.

So, Abu Jahal(ابوجَهَل) was killed, or was disabled by these two young Ansaari(أنصاري) men.

But he was laying there on the ground on the battlefield, in his last moments.

Rasool Allah ﷺ, asked the Sahabah and said; who would find out for me, What happened to Abu Jahal(ابو جَهَل).

Abdullah Bin Masood(عبدالله بن مسعود) said: so I went, and when I realize that the man laying in front of me, was Abu Jahal(ابوجَهَل).

I stepped over his neck with my foot.

He said when I recognized him, I put my foot on his neck.

He had once held me captive in Makkah and hurt me and kicked me.

And then he asked him, he said, so Allah has put you to shame then, you enemy of Allah.

Abdullah Bin Masood(عبدالله بن مسعود) is saying that Allah has shamed you, you enemyof Allah.

Abu Jahal(ابو جَهَل) said; And how has, He shamed me Aren't I the most noble man you have ever killed.

Tell me which side won the day?

Abu Jahal(ابوجَهَل) even though he's in his last moments wants to know the result of this battle.

Abdullah Bin Masood(عبدالله بن مسعود) said; it went to Allah and His messenger.

In another narration, It says that Abdullah Bin Masood(عبداللهبن مسعود) is saying that Abu Jahal(ابوجَهَل) was laying on the ground, holding a fine sword and protecting himself,

while I had the poor sword.

So, I struck his arm so his sword fell off and then I carried his sword.

And I sat on his chest to sever his head, and when I was over his chest.

He said; You've climbed very high for having being just a herdsman.

Abu Jahal(ابو جَهَل) is arrogant even when he's dying.

He's telling Abdullah Bin Masood(عبدالله بن مسعود) that for you to be on top of my chest is too high of a place for you.

Because you are but, a herdsmen, you are a Raee(راعي), Ra'al Ghanam(راعي  الغنم).

Abdullah Bin Masood(عبدالله بن مسعود) said: I then severed his head and took it to the messengerof Allah ﷺ.

Abdullah Bin Masood(عبدالله بن مسعود) said; I was as though walking on air, he was flying in the air, speeding off, Happy, to go and deliver the head of Abu Jahal(ابوجَهَل) to Rasool Allah ﷺ.

I said: this, O Messenger of Allah is the head of Allah's enemy.

Rasool Allah ﷺ said; Is it really, By Allah other than whom there is none.

I said: Yes And then I threw Abu Jahal(ابو جَهَل)'s head down in front of Rasool Allah ﷺ, who then praised Allah(عَزّوجَلّ).

In the narration of Imam Ahmad, Rasool Allah ﷺ said; Al-Hamdolillah(ألحمدلله) Allah has disgraced you, your enemy of Allah.

This man was the Pharaoh of his people.

Every nation has a Firoun(فرعون) and the Firoun(فرعون) of our nation is Abu Jahal(ابو جَهَل).

Ibn Kathir(اِبْنِ كَثِيْر) comments on the death of Abu Jahal(ابوجَهَل) and he said; the death of Abu Jahal(ابوجَهَل) came about at the hands of a youth from Al-Ansaar(ألأنصار)

their after Abdullah Bin Masood(عبدالله بن مسعود) was placed over him.

So, look at who Allah chose to kill Abu Jahal(ابوجَهَل), two young men from Al-Ansaar(ألأنصار) and Abdullah Bin Masood(عبدالله بن مسعود).

Abdullah Bin Masood(عبدالله بن مسعود), who was belittled by Abu Jahal(ابو جَهَل) Abdullah Bin Masood(عبدالله بن مسعود), who was very slightly built.

He was very thin.

One day he was climbing a palm tree and there was wind blowing, and it shook Abdullah Bin Masood(عبدالله بن مسعود), he was very light weight.

And the Sahabah laughed when they saw the thinness of the legs of Abdullah Bin Masood(عبدالله بن مسعود).

So, Rasool Allah ﷺ said Are you laughing because he has very slim legs In the name of Allah, they are heavier on the scale on the Day of Judgment than the mountain of Uhud(احد).

It's not by how pounds you can carry and how well built you are and how athletic you are and how powerful and strong you are.

Abu Jahal(ابو جَهَل), the leaderof the enemy's army was killed by Abdullah Bin Masood رضي الله عنه and by two young men from Al-Ansaar(ألأنصار).

We shouldn't depend on worldly standards.

How strong the soldier is how muscular he is.

A Muslim soldier is supposed to prepare, but not to depend on that preparation, you depend on Allah.

So, Ibn Kathir(إبن كثير) said; the death of Abu Jahal(ابوجَهَل) came about at the hands of a youth from Al-Ansaar(ألأنصار).

Their after Abdullah Bin Masood(عبدالله بن مسعود) was placed over him, by this Allah comforted the believers.

And this was more effective than if He had made a bolt of lightning strike Abu Jahal(ابو جَهَل) down or made the roof of his house fall upon him

or if he had died a natural death.

And then he recited the Ayah(آية) of Allah Fight them, Allah will punish them by your hands, not by lightning.

As Ibn Kathir(إبن كثير) says; Dying a natural death.

Allah will punish them, by your hands and will disgrace them and give you victory over them and satisfy the breasts of a believing people, and remove the fury in their hearts

and Allah turns in forgiveness to whom He wills and Allah is Knowing and Wise.

So, there's an element of revenge here because Muslims have been wronged, they've been oppressed So, Allah is saying that he will satisfy your breasts

and remove the fury in your hearts.

The Muslims were furious at the Kuffar(كفار) so Allah will remove that, when they see the faith of the enemies of Allahعَزّوجَلّ.

One of the famous fighters of Al-Mushrikeen(المشركين) he was nicknamed, Abul Kirsh(ابو الكرش), the one with the potbelly.

He was covered in armor, you could only see his eyes.

So, Az-Zubair Bin Awwamرضي الله عنه attacked him, but again this is a man covered in steel from head to toe.

Az-Zubair Bin Awwam(الزبير بن عوام), with his javelins Subhaan Allah(سُبْحَان الله), he was able to strike him right in that small opening in the eye.

But the opening was so small, so the spear, the javelin cannot go through.

So, Az-Zubair(الزبير) steps on his Javelin with his foot and forces it deep into the head of Abul Kirsh(ابو الكرش).

So, when he pulls out his Javelin, the blade was bent, so bad and this shows you the strength of Az-Zubair Bin Awwam رضي الله عنه, it was amazing that the blade was bent in such a fashion.

So, Rasool Allah ﷺ asked to keep that Javelin as a souvenir And Subhaan Allah(سُبْحَان الله), when Rasool Allah ﷺ passed away, Abu Bakr(ابو بكر) asked for it.

And when Abu Bakr(ابو بكر) passed away, Umar(عُمَر) asked for it, and when Umar(عُمَر) pass away, Az-Zubair(الزبير) got it, back again, it was his

but then Uthman(عثمان) asked Az-Zubair(الزبير) to give it to him.

So, Az-Zubair(الزبير) hands it over to the Khalifah(خليفه) Uthman Ibn Affan(عثمان ابن عفان).

And when Uthman(عثمان) passes away, Ali(علي) takes it, and then after Ali Ibn Abi Talib(علي ابن ابي طالب), Abdullah Bin Zubair(عبدالله بن زبير), the son of Zubair(الزبير), gets it.

Abul-Bukhtari(ابوا لبختري) was one of the noble man of Quraish(قُرَيْشْ).

He was a Mushrik(مشرك), a disbeliever but he wasn't cruel against the Muslims.

In fact, he was one of the men, who participated in the ending of the siege, against the Muslims.

If you remember in Makkah, there was a siege that lasted for three years against Bannu Hashim(بنو هاشم) and Bannu Ul-Muttalib(بنوالمطلب), the family of Rasool Allahﷺ.

Abul Bukhtari(ابولبختري) was one of the men, who ended this siege.

So, Rasool Allah ﷺ was grateful to him and he asked the Muslims not to kill him, if you see him in battle.

So there's a lesson to learn here you know that some Mushrikeen(مشركين), even though they are Mushrikeen(مشركين), they are disbelievers but if they do you good, then reciprocate.

So, Rasool Allah ﷺ said, If you see him, Don't kill him, leave him.

So, one of Al-Ansaar(أنْصَار) saw Al-Bukhtari Bin Hishaam(ألبختري بن هشام) and told him that Rasool Allahﷺ told us not to kill you.

Al-Bukhtari(البختري) said; What about my companion? He had a friend with him.

He said, Well no, we're not going to spare your companion death.

We're going to kill him.

Al-Bukhtari Bin Hisham(ألبختري بن هشام) said; then I'm going to protect my companion, I'm going to fight to protect him.

And thus, the Ansari(انصاري) was forced to fight Al-Bukhtari(البختري), and he was killed.

Then he went back to Rasool Allah ﷺ and said, I swear by Him, Who sent you with the truth, I did try to take him prisoner to bring him to you,

but he insisted on fighting me.

So, I fought back and killed him.
